title: Walsingham to Burghley, Paris, 12 November 1572, letter-book copy, BL Harley MS 260 ff. 364-365 (DECODE R8359-R8360, catalogue item 126)

documents.shelfmark: BL Harley MS 260 ff. 364-365 (DECODE R8359, R8360)

plaintext.source: No cipher signs copied; placeholders [9]/[3]. Digges 1655 prints the same copy.

transcription.notes: Clear English; six boxed placeholder digits and one blank where cipher names stood.

system.summary: No cipher copied: the letter-book clerk replaced each cipher name with a boxed number ([9], [3]).

prior_solution.where: Digges, The Compleat Ambassador (1655) prints the letter with the placeholders; no decipherment.

conditions.human_role: Project-level: set up Claude Code with Opus 5 and posed the catalogue entry with /goal. No target-specific intervention recorded.

solution.what: Viewed R8359 (2 images) and R8360: clear letter-book copies of Walsingham to Burghley, 12 Nov 1572; cipher replaced by [9] x5, [3] x1 and a blank.
Found the letter in Digges 1655 (djvu text): printed with the same placeholders, not deciphered.
Checked DECODE R8359/R8360 for more images: 2 + 1 only, all viewed.
CSP For. x November 1572 (BHO) and web search for the 12 Nov letter or its original with cipher: not calendared, not found.

outcome.method_basis: The Harley 260 letter-book copy holds no cipher signs: the copyist boxed placeholders ([9], [3]) where the cipher names stood, and Digges 1655 prints the same gaps.
outcome.notes: Closed: no ciphertext survives in this copy.

gaps.item: six placeholders and one blank, ff. 364r-365r
